verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only pre-built AI automations (JAX auto-categorization/reconciliation, bill-data extraction) and API/SDK/MCP access for developers, but nothing describing a user-facing capability to define custom rules that trigger actions on arbitrary events (e.g., a rules/workflow engine or webhooks). Missing for 10: any documentation of a rules engine, event triggers, or webhook-based automation configurable by the user.
